name: Smoke test
browserSteps: Navigate with Playwright MCP, inspect the rendered page, click links/buttons and test keyboard focus and responsive viewports. Record observed DOM changes, screenshots and console logs for each tested flow; a checklist alone is not an executed test.
prompt:
Act as a Senior Software Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist and Lead Accessibility Auditor. Your task is to test {{URL}} using the following checklist and when done, generate a report 

Instructions & Tone
Maintain a thorough, structured, and developer-friendly approach.

Include actionable test cases for each area, including clear verification criteria.

Organize items into clear categories with checkboxes ([ ]) for easy tracking.

Checklist Requirements
Please build the QA checklist covering, but not limited to, the following core pillars:

Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 / WCAG 2.0 AA Compliance)

Keyboard navigation & focus indicators.

Screen reader compatibility (ARIA labels, alt text, landmarks).

Alt text for images that convey meaningful information to the user.

Color contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large text).

Form field labeling and accessible error messaging.

Design, UI & Responsive Viewports

Cross-device viewport testing (Desktop 1920px+, Laptop 1366px, Tablet 768px, Mobile 375px).

Alignment, padding, typography consistency, and layout shifts (CLS).

Dark mode / Light mode consistency (if applicable).

Links, Media & Asset Integrity

Full URL sweep ensuring zero broken links or 404 errors (internal, external, footer, legal links).

Image rendering check: no broken images, missing fallbacks, or incorrect aspect ratios.

Performance checks for image optimization (WebP/SVG usage, lazy loading).

JavaScript Functionality & Console Health

Zero unhandled console errors or critical warnings during standard user flows.

Event listeners firing correctly (clicks, dropdowns, modals, toggles).

Form handling: client-side validation, submit actions, loading states, and success/error feedback.

General Core Functionality & Edge Cases

Critical user journeys (e.g., authentication, checkout, search, filtering).

State management on page refresh, browser back/forward buttons, and session timeouts.

Input field edge cases (SQL injection prevention inputs, extremely long strings, special characters/emojis).

Content, Copy & Grammar

Proofreading for grammar, spelling, typos, and formatting consistency across all pages.

Microcopy check: button labels, tooltips, toast notifications, and dynamic error state text.

Dynamic data placeholders (e.g., {first_name} or Lorem Ipsum) removed completely.

Frontend & Coding Best Practices

Semantic HTML structure (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>, proper heading hierarchy H1-H6).

SEO metadata check (<title>, <meta description>, Open Graph tags).

Security basics (HTTPS enforcement, safe external link attributes rel="noopener noreferrer").

Report Format
Format the output as a readable pdf or html document, grouped by category using subheadings, bullet points, and checkable task lists ([ ]). Under each checklist item, include a brief How to Test / Criteria note where appropriate.

name: Accessibility audit
browserSteps: Navigate with Playwright MCP. Inspect the accessibility snapshot, press Tab and test focus/keyboard activation. Save screenshots and observed focus/DOM states. Distinguish automated browser checks from NOT TESTED manual screen-reader checks; unavailable browser infrastructure means BLOCKED.
prompt: Do an accessibility audit of {{URL}} (WCAG 2.2 AA). List issues with severity and suggested fixes.

name: Form validation
browserSteps: Navigate with Playwright MCP, inspect forms, fill empty/invalid/valid inputs and submit where safe. Record validation messages and resulting DOM state/screenshots. If no forms exist, prove that with a browser snapshot and still test keyboard focus. Do not perform destructive submissions or transactions without approval.
prompt: Find all forms on {{URL}} and test the validation with valid, empty and invalid input. Report the results as a table.
